description: Lists launch directories and maker communities where a new product can be listed, each checked by reading the site: cost (free, free with conditions, or paid), whether an account is needed, and the conditions for a free listing (badge, upvotes, waiting time). ai_product.description: True if the product uses AI; AI-only directories are left out when false

price.description: Only free routes, only paid, or any (default any)
